question: My oven won't light and I've checked the gas line and burner. What could be the problem?
answer: To replace the oven igniter, first disconnect the power to the oven. Then, remove the oven racks and shelves. Next, remove the oven door and any other obstructions. Locate the igniter and disconnect the electrical connector. Remove the screws holding the igniter in place and gently pull it out. Install the new igniter by reversing the process.
steps: Disconnect the power to the oven
Remove the oven racks and shelves
Remove the oven door and any other obstructions
Locate the igniter and disconnect the electrical connector
Remove the screws holding the igniter in place and gently pull it out
safety_info: When working with electrical and gas components, make sure to turn off the power and gas supply to the oven. Wear protective gloves and safety glasses to avoid injury from sharp edges or flying debris.
tips: Use a wrench to loosen any stubborn screws
Make sure the new igniter is properly seated before reassembling the oven
